primary_dataset.name: nflverse/nfldata
primary_dataset.tier_definition: Open community dataset. Not an NFL official publication. Used for market numbers (lines) and results, which the NFL does not publish in machine-readable form.
primary_dataset.licence_note: See repo LICENSE / README for terms.

games.csv.what_it_provides: One row per game 1999-2026: scores, spread_line, total_line, moneylines, rest days, roof, surface, temp, wind, div_game, referee, stadium.

closing_lines.csv.what_it_provides: Per-side closing moneyline / spread / total with price and outcome (2006 onward).

initial_lines.csv.what_it_provides: Opening lines by sportsbook (WSGT), 2021 onward. Used only for open->close movement / CLV work.

sc_lines.csv.what_it_provides: Secondary book spread lines, 2013 onward. Used as a cross-book sanity check only.

teams.csv.what_it_provides: Team code disambiguation across NFL/ESPN/PFR/PFF/SBR ids, by season.

official_sources.note: The NFL does not publish point spreads, totals or player-prop prices. Rules, scoring, overtime, tie-breaks and bet-settlement mechanics DO have official sources and are cited from research/sources.md. No line value in this project is attributed to an NFL official source.

known_data_irregularities: surface column contains a trailing-space duplicate ('grass ' vs 'grass') - 93 rows.
roof/surface/temp/wind have NaN in some rows (26 roof, 87 surface, 2213 temp).
2026 season is in progress: 136 of 272 scheduled regular-season games have lines/scores; the rest are blank and excluded from every calculation.
temp/wind have no provenance field in the dataset - they are not independently verified and are labelled UNVERIFIED in any table that shows them.
